title: Blog Post Management API Documentation
description: A RESTful blog management backend that handles user authentication, role-based access control, blog post creation, and comment management. The API supports secure JWT authentication, CRUD operations for blog posts, user-owned content management, admin privileges, and a comment system with edit tracking and moderation capabilities. Fully documented and publicly accessible through Postman for testing and integration.

title: Blog Post Management System
description: Full-stack blog platform built with the MEVN stack. Features include user authentication, role-based access control, CRUD blog posts, nested comment system, and admin moderation tools.

title: E-commerce API Documentation
description: Dynamic E-Commerce Workflow Management. The system features dynamic routes for order processing, real-time inventory updates, and secure user authentication. It also supports seamless automated order reporting and comprehensive product management. Documented Backend API published publicly using Postman.

title: E-commerce App
description: MEVN E-Commerce Platform with product catalog, real-time search, seamless cart updates, secure checkout, and admin dashboard with analytics.

title: Fitness Tracking API Documentation
description: A structured fitness tracking backend that manages user authentication, workout records, exercise routines, and progress monitoring. It enables real-time tracking of fitness activities, automated activity summaries, and organized data handling for seamless integration with the frontend. Documented Backend API published publicly using Postman.

title: Fitness Tracking App
description: A full-stack fitness tracking application that allows users to log workouts, track progress, manage exercise routines, and monitor daily fitness activity with a clean and responsive UI.

title: MovieVault API Documentation
description: A RESTful movie management backend that handles user authentication, role-based access control, movie catalog management, and movie comments. The API supports CRUD operations for movies, secure JWT authentication, admin-only actions, and user-generated comments. Fully documented and publicly accessible through Postman for testing and integration.

title: Movie App Client
description: A full-stack movie management application with user authentication, movie catalog browsing, CRUD operations for admins, and a comment system for user engagement.

title: 3D Portfolio Website
description: An interactive 3D portfolio built with Next.js, React Three Fiber, Drei, Three.js, and Tailwind CSS. Features dynamic 3D models, responsive design, smooth navigation, and cross-device compatibility while showcasing projects, technical skills, and professional experience through an engaging user experience.

title: Calculator
description: Responsive calculator built with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, supporting basic arithmetic operations, clear and backspace functions, and keyboard input.

title: Etch-A-Sketch

title: Tic Tac Toe
description: Classic 3x3 two-player game built with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, featuring win detection and game reset functionality.

title: Weather App
description: Responsive weather application built with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript as part of The Odin Project Fullstack course, using a Weather API to display current weather conditions and temperature based on city searches.
